sections.text_helper: Section 32.6.8 "ADC channel preselection register (ADC_PCSEL)" in chapter 32 (Analog-to-digital converters (ADC)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1552.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x01C
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:20 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 19:0 PCSEL[19:0]: Channel i (VINP[i]) preselection
These bits are written by software to preselect the input channel I/O to be converted.
0: Input channel i (VINP[i]) is not preselected for conversion, the result of the ADC conversion
for this channel is wrong
1: Input channel i (VINP[i]) is preselected for conversion
Note: The software is allowed to write these bits only when ADSTART=0 and
JADSTART=0 (which ensures that no conversion is ongoing).
Configuring the PCSEL bit is not necessary for the internal channels (such as
VREFINT).
